title: My Thesis Project "CLEARSPEAK"
shortDesc: AI-powered speech recognition for people with cleft lip and palate
fullDescription: CLEARSPEAK is an AI-powered speech recognition system designed to transcribe and assist people with cleft lip and palate (CLP) speech impediments. Built as a portable, offline-capable device, it runs on Raspberry Pi with Arduino integration for GPIO control.
overview: CLEARSPEAK leverages advanced AI to transcribe speech in real-time, improving communication accessibility and confidence. The system is fully offline, requires no internet connectivity, and operates as a portable lapel-style wearable.
features: Offline Speech Recognition using OpenAI's Whisper base model
Real-time Transcription with low-latency processing
Multi-Voice Selection with 3 different voice options
Portable & Rechargeable battery-powered design
HDMI Display Support for flexible output options
Hardware Integration with Raspberry Pi + Arduino
Zero Internet Dependency for complete privacy
achievement: 🏆 Thesis Champion — College of Engineering Thesis Competition (2026)

title: 2nd Sumobot
shortDesc: Competitive sumo robot with 6 motors and advanced sensor integration
fullDescription: Sumobot V2 is the second-generation competitive sumo robot designed for university-level competitions. This autonomous robot competes against other university teams with enhanced capabilities from the first generation.
overview: Building on lessons learned from V1, this improved version features 6 low-gear motors for maximum pushing power and intelligent multi-sensor navigation.
features: 6 Low-Gear Motors for high torque capability
3 Ultrasonic Sensors for opponent and boundary detection
IR Sensors for dohyo ring boundary detection via ground reflection
Ring Boundary Detection to keep robot inside competition ring
Autonomous Navigation with sensor-driven decision making
Compact Design optimized for agility

title: Led Controlled by Sound sensor
shortDesc: Sound-reactive LED system that responds to clapping patterns
fullDescription: A sound-reactive LED control system that uses a microphone to detect clapping patterns. This Arduino-based project demonstrates audio input processing and real-time LED control through pattern recognition.
overview: Simple yet elegant project showcasing sensor integration and embedded systems control during second year of college.
features: Clap Detection via microphone-based sound trigger
Pattern Recognition: 1 clap → Red LED, 2 claps → Blue LED
Multiple claps trigger RGB LED blinking sequence
Real-time Response with immediate feedback
RGB Control for full color support

title: 1st Sumobot
shortDesc: First-generation autonomous sumo robot for university competitions
fullDescription: The original sumobot project developed during 2nd year of college. This was the first autonomous sumo robot, built to compete against senior students. Despite initial challenges, it demonstrated early autonomous robotics capabilities.
overview: A significant learning experience tackling the complexities of multi-sensor integration and autonomous motor control for the first time.
features: Fully Autonomous operation with AI-driven decision making
Multi-Sensor Integration for coordinated sensing
Ultrasonic Sensors for opponent detection
IR Sensors for dohyo boundary detection
Ring Boundary Detection via ground reflection sensing
Motor Control System for autonomous advantage

title: The making of Analog and Digital Trainer
shortDesc: Comprehensive electronics training platform for logic and analog circuits
fullDescription: A multi-functional trainer platform designed for learning and testing electronic logic circuits. This educational device enables hands-on exploration of digital logic gates, IC testing, analog circuits, and signal generation.
overview: Perfect for students and enthusiasts to understand and test various electronic components in a controlled, hands-on environment.
features: Digital Logic Testing for various gate types
Arduino Integration for effective IC validation
8-Channel Pull-Down Switches for manual input control
8-Channel Output Display for real-time IC state feedback
PWM Module for signal generation testing
Variable Voltage Regulator (0-12V)
Fixed Voltage Outputs (3V, 5V, 9V, 12V)
Integrated Speaker for audio signal testing

title: Temperature and Humidity Sensor PCB
shortDesc: Custom-designed PCB using toner transfer and chemical etching
fullDescription: A custom-designed printed circuit board for temperature and humidity sensing. This was the first PCB designed and fabricated from scratch, demonstrating hands-on experience with circuit design, PCB manufacturing, and soldering.
overview: Showcases the complete PCB development workflow from design to working prototype using DIY fabrication techniques.
features: Temperature Sensing for accurate measurements
Humidity Sensing for real-time detection
Custom PCB Design optimized for compact form
DIY Fabrication using toner transfer and chemical etching
Professional EasyEDA circuit design
Efficient trace routing
achievement: Successful design, fabrication, and assembly from scratch

title: Doorbell with bluetooth messaging system
shortDesc: Smart Bluetooth doorbell with mobile app control and status messaging
fullDescription: An intelligent doorbell system that connects via Bluetooth to a homeowner's smartphone. This IoT device enables remote doorbell management and visitor notifications.
overview: Modernizes traditional doorbell functionality by adding remote control and smart notifications, giving homeowners flexibility in managing visitor access.
features: Bluetooth Connectivity to smartphone
Remote Control via mobile phone app
Availability Status modes (Nobody Home, Do Not Disturb, Active)
Real-Time Notifications to smartphone
Visitor Awareness with customizable messages
Portable Control from anywhere

title: Terminated an Ethernet cable
shortDesc: Proper LAN cable termination with RJ45 connectors
fullDescription: A practical networking project from the Cisco curriculum focused on proper Ethernet cable termination techniques. This foundational skill demonstrates understanding of network infrastructure standards.
overview: Master proper LAN cable preparation, stripping, and RJ45 connector termination according to industry standards (EIA/TIA 568A and 568B).
features: Cable Preparation and wire organization
Wire Sequencing following EIA/TIA standards
RJ45 Crimping with proper pressure
Connector Standards (568A vs 568B)
Cable Testing for verification
Quality Control methodology

title: Arduino to RPI 5 that uses Optocoupler
shortDesc: CLEARSPEAK Arduino controller with optocoupler isolation and battery monitoring
fullDescription: The dedicated Arduino subsystem for CLEARSPEAK thesis project. This microcontroller handles critical hardware control, battery monitoring, and safe communication with Raspberry Pi through optocoupler isolation.
overview: Serves as the bridge between physical hardware and main processing unit while protecting the Raspberry Pi from electrical surges.
features: Optocoupler Isolation for surge protection
Button Control for user input
Battery Voltage Monitoring
Shutdown Prevention before complete battery drain
Sensor Interface for voltage reading
Power Management for graceful shutdown
Real-time Communication via isolated serial

title: 4 BIT counter
shortDesc: Digital logic circuit displaying ID number using 4-bit counter and logic gates
fullDescription: A digital logic circuit project that displays a student ID number and first initial using a 4-bit counter system. Demonstrates practical application of logic gates and timing circuits.
overview: Showcases understanding of combinational logic, sequential circuits, and real-world application of TTL integrated circuits.
features: 4-Bit Counter using logic gate ICs
Truth Table Logic for display design
NE555 Timer for clock signal generation
Logic Gate ICs for output decoding
Automatic Cycling with continuous loop
LED Display for binary output
